preset.purpose: The movement-numbers instrument on the metrics course: top speed and time to reach it, the jump at a full sprint, standing jump, stop, turn and air steering, and for gaps, ledges, steps and slopes the largest stepped piece that succeeds and the first that fails. Feeds docs/metrics.json when traversal closes.

tick_cost_ms.what: wall time of one tick's scripts: every body's move and the instruments watching them
